review:
Hot Slot: 777 Cash Out Grand Diamond Edition is a retro Wazdan slot built around one feature. A retro Hot Slot game built around Sticky Cash Out, in what Wazdan calls its most rewarding version of the feature. Rather than waiting for a separate bonus, the action stays in the base game, with Cash Out labels sticking around to build up prizes.

The Grand Jackpot is 3,500x, a big number for a retro sevens game, and Chance Level lets you multiply your bet to improve your odds. High volatility, 96.15% RTP. Wazdan's page is light on exact rules, so spin the demo first to see how often Cash Out comes into play. The free demo is the best way to see how often Cash Out comes into play.
